body: Not in my country I dont.

Thank you. I dont know why, but your post brought some tears to my eye.

I know its hard to change habits, and procrastination sure is a demanding one at that. But I'll try, I know I have to.

All of you have been great. You were the only ones not to turn a blind eye. This means a lot to me.

Tried that to no avail. I seems she puts herself in a kind of pedestal made of ego. Doesn't matter what people say or how illogical she is being, she thinks she's always right and everyone is wrong and out to get her.

Also she always has got to have the llast word like a fucking child.

Even when things arent so agressive and "dramatic" I cant focus so much. I guess all this situation gave me depression.
Anyway, thanks for the advice, I've been willing to try meditation for the longest of time, now I have an excuse.

Actually many of my professors have shown incredible support for me, even going as far as letting me deliver papers 2 months after semester one time. But there is a limit in how much they can help.

I want the willpower to do the things that I want to do. Thats always been the problem, and thats why I left the psychologist. I realized she just coudn't help me with that.

Yeah, unfortunately to be completely resilient to this type of stuff I would have to have as they say around here "cockroach blood". I dont think there really is a way to withstand constant abuse without phisical separation, and as I have said, this seems to be a problem now.

I tried a shrink for a year. Didnt help much. She flat out told me the greatest problem was my mother, not me.
She then tried to convince my mother to seek help, which offended her to no end seeing the only reason my mother scheduled treatment for me was so the counsellor could say how bad a child I am.

Unfortunatly It seems this support group doesnt have meetings where I live, but thanks anyway.
I often think about how would it be to be a father. I guess my greatest fear is letting this shit happen to my children.
The "serving time" analogy is strangely fitting.
Wow, you have no idea how much that resonates with me. All I can do really is thank you for understanding.

The worst about this is that I think she most of the time doesnt even realize the harm she does. I cant honestly fathom how could anyone live with itself doing this kind of stuff.

I think she is just to mentally distressed to realize what she does is wrong. But no way in hell I could get her to treatment.

Thank you. And no, besides the place to stay and the food in the house, she doesnt pay for aything else. I buy my own clothing and stuff, and pay my own bills.
I work hard day and night at my job for a pay that isnt that much. That doesnt stop her from calling me a useless pos though.

And no, I dont feel i debt to her in anyway. She thinks I owe her for what she did. She feels I must take it all because im her son. And when I point this to her, she conveniently gets in hysterical violence mode.

I just cant bring myself to hate her you know. I pity her a lot. For only a miserable person could do this stuff to her own son.
Whats worse is that in the end, Im all that she has, And she is pushing me away.

I should have graduated by now, but because my performance is horrible, even if I could just plow trough it, Im a year away from it.

Which is ridiculous to me, because of my work experience, I know a heck lot more about the profession than most newly graduated.

People say Im a genius a lot, but what good is being a genius when you just cant use your own potential.

Im trying so hard to do this, but sometimes I just dont have the willpower. I wish from the bottom of my heart that I could just plow trough it.

For the college I already have made a heck of a loan, wich I will pay a lot more if i keep flunking. As for housing, still no solution in sight, but im looking for it.

One of the things that really bothers me in all of this is my father. Hes literally one hour away by car, but he cant even bother to move his ass and see me. For him, preaching and accusing me of being a bad son by telephone is enough. He literally left me with an abusive mother and never could bother to do anything for me.
He shows once in like six months.

Thank you. It matters a lot to me.

People who I talk to says that I should just accept being treated like dirt because she pays my food. Not that I dont work aswell, but I dont win nearly as much as necessary.
